from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tarfile
import tempfile

base = '6ff0febba890567b98fad38d495a9c7e02a144cf'
expected_paths = {
    'DEPLOYMENT.md',
    'scripts/production-preflight.py',
    'scripts/tests/test_production_preflight.py',
}
patch = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--binary', base], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
changed = set(subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', base], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines())
if changed "'!= expected_paths:
    raise SystemExit(f'"'unexpected changed paths: {sorted(changed)}')
head = subprocess.run(['git', 'archive', base], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='sysgrid-chg56-patch-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'base'
    root.mkdir()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=BytesIO(head), mode='r:') as archive:
        archive.extractall(root)
    patch_path = Path(temporary) / 'r3.patch'
    patch_path.write_bytes(patch)
    apply_check = subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '--check', str(patch_path)], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if apply_check.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(apply_check.stderr or f'git apply --check exit {apply_check.returncode}')

forbidden = re.compile(r'(?i)\\b(?:codex|opencode|chatgpt|claude|gemini|llm|autonomous agent)\\b|/v1/(?:responses|chat/completions)')
if forbidden.search(patch.decode()):
    raise SystemExit('forbidden terminal-side AI/agent command reference found in patch')
secret_patterns = [
    re.compile(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'),
    re.compile(r'(?i)-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----'),
    re.compile(r'(?i)\\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\\b'),
    re.compile(r'(?i)\\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{24,}\\b'),
]
if any(pattern.search(patch.decode()) for pattern in secret_patterns):
    raise SystemExit('credential pattern found in patch')
if re.search(r'/Users/["'^/]+/|/private/var/|/tmp/'"', patch.decode()):
    raise SystemExit('local absolute path found in patch')
print(f'patch_sha256={sha256(patch).hexdigest()}')
print(f'changed_files={\",\".join(sorted(changed))}')
print('git_apply_check=PASS')
print('forbidden_command_scan=PASS')
print('credential_and_local_path_scan=PASS')
